scenarios.name: Open and cancels Create Block from the expanded Create panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/construction/regular-circle-12mm.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the Sketch Create panel's additional command area is open
the user selects Create Block from that area
the Create Block dialog opens over the sketch
the dialog offers geometry and insert-point selectors
the block name and description fields are visible
the dialog closes without creating a block
the sketch remains active and unchanged
